Web search API prices per 1,000 searches Each dot is one of 96 paid APIs. Log scale. Hover or tab to a dot for its price; the table below has every value. Scroll sideways to see the whole chart. ## Price per 1,000 searches No provider matches that. List prices, as each provider publishes them. Provider names are trademarks of their owners. Listing a provider does not imply a partnership. ## How the price is worked out - Each price comes from the provider's own pricing page, checked on 17 November 2026. - A row shows the provider's entry plan: the cheapest way to start paying for web search. Enterprise and contact-sales plans are left out. - A search is one request at the provider's cheapest search mode and default result count. - A per-search price is multiplied by 1,000. A subscription or pack is divided by the searches it includes, then multiplied by 1,000. Credits are converted at the plan's credit price. - When a high-volume plan costs half the entry price or less, that rate is shown as the price at volume. - Prices in other currencies are converted to USD. - Page content is whether one search request can return the full text of each result, or only titles, links and snippets. - A price marked est. is worked out from credits or plan limits, because the provider does not state a price per search. Voxoria's own per-call prices are on the catalog and the web search tool page .
